templates.why_chosen: Two-level global/local scheduler hierarchy with a right-hand legend separating migration control (orange solid) from other control (dashed).
templates.what_to_learn: One expanded instance beside two schematic ones communicates scale-out; the legend then only has to explain the one arrow class that matters.
